mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notices ( id, space_id, event_id, title, body, important, pinned, audience, status, version, first_published_at, published_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES ( #{id}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{title}, #{body}, #{important}, #{pinned}, CAST(#{audience} AS jsonb), #{status}, 1, #{publishedAt}, #{publishedAt}, #{actorId}, #{at}, #{actorId}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, important = #{important}, pinned = #{pinned}, audience = CAST(#{audience} AS jsonb), status = #{status}, version = version + 1, first_published_at = #{firstPublishedAt}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, edited_at = #{editedAt}, archived_at = #{archivedAt}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = #{at} WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notices WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice_boards (space_id, event_id, version, updated_at) VALUES (#{spaceId}, #{eventId}, 1, #{at}) ON CONFLICT (space_id, event_id) DO UPDATE SET version = notice_boards.version + 1, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
